nodes.title: minGain has never bound once: 0 of 208 rounds would change decision at any threshold from 0.001 to 0.9
nodes.body: Replayed every gate.evaluated event in all 69 campaigns (research/exp/e20.mjs) and recomputed the decision at minGain = 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 0.9. Rounds whose decision would differ from the recorded one: 0 at every threshold. The reason is structural, not a coincidence: scores are 0 (72 rounds) or 1 (136 rounds), so the only reachable margins are 0 and 1, and only 17 of 208 rounds carry an incumbent at all (margin 0 in 16, 1 in 1). bestPriorScore requires a landed round with a promotedAttemptId, so a task that never promoted has no incumbent and beatsIncumbent is trivially true. The config field gate.minGain, the whole sample-size / MDE / PACE apparatus that depends on it, and the review protocol in docs/contracts.md that describes a delta test: none of it is connected to a decision the loop has ever made. minGain is a setting with no observable effect, which is worse than a mis-set one because it reads as configured rigour.
